title: Finite-stage Verdier biduality
statement:
Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type scheme over
$k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, and let $A=A_{E,n}$.
On either the small etale site or the small pro-etale site,

$$
D_Y=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_Y),\qquad \omega_Y=Ra_Y^!A,
$$

is a contravariant exact anti-equivalence of $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$,
and the natural map $\delta_K:K\to D_YD_YK$ is an isomorphism.
No boundary duality input is a hypothesis of this theorem.

proof.text: Work at the finite coefficient stage $A=A_{E,n}$ with $n\ge1$ and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$. On the etale site, [lem-weil-verdier-preservation-strata] carries $D^b_{ctf}$ into itself; applying it to the constant free rank-one sheaf $A_Y$ of Tor interval $[0,0]$ gives bounded constructibility and finite Tor amplitude for $\omega_{Y,\mathrm{et}}=D_{Y,\mathrm{et}}A_Y$. The natural double-dual map is an isomorphism and the duality is an exact anti-equivalence by [thm-weil-etale-geometric-biduality]. Here $A_Y$ is constructible with Tor interval $[0,0]$ because it is the constant finite coefficient ring and tensoring over $A_Y$ with $A_Y$ is the identity. In the K-injective model of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], the termwise maps $\mathcal Hom_A(A_Y,I^j)\cong I^j$ commute with differentials, giving $D_{Y,\mathrm{et}}A_Y\cong\omega_{Y,\mathrm{et}}$.

source.place: Sole proof paragraph: etale duality, descent, and evaluation-compatible comparison

proof.text: Put $F=\nu_Y^*$. Clause (ii) of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] gives a bounded constructible etale representative $K'$ of every bounded constructible pro-etale $K$. Clause (ii) of [lem-sf-comparison-tor-amplitude] reflects the finite Tor interval from $K$ to $K'$, while clause (i) preserves that interval under $F$. Therefore the comparison equivalence restricts to the two finite-Tor constructible categories. The representative $K'$ is bounded and therefore bounded below, as required by reflection; $\ell$ is invertible on $Y$ since $\ell\ne p$ and $Y$ is a $k$-scheme.

source.place: Sole proof paragraph: etale duality, descent, and evaluation-compatible comparison

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison] to $K'$ and $\omega_{Y,\mathrm{et}}$. Its dualizing-object and evaluation-compatible comparison gives a natural isomorphism $c_{K'}:F D_{\mathrm{et}}K'\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{\mathrm{proet}}F K'$. Since the etale dual is finite-Tor constructible and $F$ preserves finite Tor amplitude, the pro-etale dual is finite-Tor constructible as well; applying the same comparison to $D_{\mathrm{et}}K'$ gives the corresponding comparison for the second dual.

source.place: Sole proof paragraph: etale duality, descent, and evaluation-compatible comparison

proof.text:
The comparison lemma's compatibility with evaluation and transposes identifies the pro-etale double-dual map with the composite
$$F K'\xrightarrow{F\delta_{K'}}F D_{\mathrm{et}}D_{\mathrm{et}}K'\xrightarrow{c_{D_{\mathrm{et}}K'}}D_{\mathrm{proet}}F D_{\mathrm{et}}K'\xrightarrow{D_{\mathrm{proet}}(c_{K'}^{-1})}D_{\mathrm{proet}}D_{\mathrm{proet}}F K'.$$
Every arrow is invertible, so naturality gives the result for $K\cong F K'$. The comparison statement then transports the exact contravariant anti-equivalence from the etale category to the pro-etale category; its exceptional inverse image is the specified comparison-class transport, so no ambient pro-etale adjoint or boundary-duality hypothesis is used.
